analyst.summary: JK Paper is an established Indian paper and packaging-board maker going through a genuine industry-wide margin squeeze -- operating margins have more than halved over the past few years due to pulp/energy cost inflation and import competition. The company has just started a new pulp facility (BCTMP) aimed at reducing import dependence, which could help margins recover over time. We rate it a Hold: revenue growth remains modest and steady, but current profitability is weak and a real recovery in returns depends on the cycle turning and the new capacity ramping successfully.
